rationale_overall: This is the day-0-plus-one curation on the starter watchlist, so the goal is filling the most obvious thematic gaps the profile already names rather than trimming: RKLB and IONQ give direct, already-listed exposure to the rockets/spacecraft and quantum-computing 'likely next waves,' and ITA captures the geopolitical/rearmament wave that just received a concrete catalyst in the Ukraine invasion. Nuclear (SMR) was searched but NuScale's SPAC merger does not close until May 2022, so no fission vehicle exists yet; robotics and aging-demographics searches turned up no Q1-2022-dated catalyst strong enough to clear the bar. No removes: all five starter tickers are unchanged holdings with no thesis breach.
